verified_facts.text: Claridge's is in the heart of Mayfair, London.
verified_facts.excerpt: Claridge’s, in the heart of Mayfair, is shaped by centuries of enduring artistry
Since its founding in 1812, Claridge’s has stood as a beacon of elegance in the heart of Mayfair.

verified_facts.text: The suites and rooms span Victorian opulence, Art Deco glamour and contemporary elegance.
verified_facts.excerpt: they span Victorian opulence, Art Deco glamour, and contemporary elegance

verified_facts.text: The lobby, with its chequered floor, captures the Art Deco glamour of the Jazz Age.
verified_facts.excerpt: The lobby still captures the Art Deco glamour of the Jazz Age when flapper girls once hobnobbed with European royalty. You feel an instant buzz on entering its chequered-floor expanse

verified_facts.text: The subterranean spa was designed by Andre Fu, with limewood and stone textures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by André Fu, its limewood and stone textures and dreamy peachy hues are the backdrop for signature bamboo-stick massages

verified_facts.text: The spa's swimming pool sits beneath a vaulted ceiling, surrounded by stone columns and cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The swimming pool ripples beneath a vaulted ceiling and is surrounded by stone columns and cushy cabanas.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a sauna, steam rooms and a spacious fitness centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: there’s also a sauna, steam rooms, changing rooms and a spacious fitness centre.

verified_facts.text: The suites feature balconies overlooking Brook Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suites feature balconies overlooking Brook Street.

verified_facts.text: The Georgian suite has a Steinberg baby grand piano, a fully equipped kitchen and a 24-hour butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s a Steinberg baby grand piano in the living room, embroidered silk de Gournay panels in the dining room, a fully-equipped kitchen, and a 24-hour butler.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea includes bespoke Claridge's blends prepared by Henrietta Lovell of the Rare Tea Company.
verified_facts.excerpt: includes bespoke Claridge’s blends prepared by Henrietta Lovell of the Rare Tea Company.

verified_facts.text: The Fumoir is a cosy, darkwood 1930s-style bar serving vintage signature cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: lose yourself in the cosy, darkwood interiors of the 1930s-style Fumoir while sipping on their vintage, signature cocktails

verified_facts.text: The ArtSpace Cafe, designed by John Pawson, has its own entrance on Brook's Mews and a gallery of rotating exhibitions.
verified_facts.excerpt: The new ArtSpace Café, designed by John Pawson, has its own dedicated entrance on Brook’s Mews.

verified_facts.text: New York's Dante has a permanent address at Claridge's, serving cocktails and aperitivo-style dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: New York icon Dante establishes a permanent address at Claridge’s.

verified_facts.text: Claridge's has a shop of homeware, including an in-house range and pieces made for Claridge's by designers and artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover exclusive pieces from our in-house range alongside designs created especially for Claridge’s by our favourite designers and artisans.

verified_facts.text: There is elevator access to all floors, and the restaurant, bar and reception areas are flat.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant, bar and reception areas are all flat, and there is elevator access to all floors.

verified_facts.text: Mayfair is a quiet neighbourhood of Georgian townhouses, refined restaurants and Savile Row shops.
verified_facts.excerpt: Quiet Mayfair scores nil points for cool and trendy, but those wanting a chocolate-box vision of London full of elegant Georgian townhouses, refined restaurants, and Savile Row shops can get their full fix here.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Dyson Supersonic hairdryers and free Wi-Fi.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms have Dyson Supersonic hairdryers and free Wi-Fi.
